selection: Global deterministic SHA256 cmrc-v5:<id> ordering; max1 per normalized article title; all references must have valid raw offsets and be nonempty; input<=2048 tokens with frozen tokenizer/prompt; reject exact IDs/text and char5gram-context Jaccard>=0.70 or question SequenceMatcher>=0.90 duplicates within chosen sample and against all old project evaluation/training rows. Stop at96, abort if insufficient. No model-output-based eligibility.
metric: Primary strict EM after boundary strip against any reference. Supplemental normalized EM (NFC, casefold, remove Unicode punctuation and whitespace) and character-sequence LCS F1. Not official CMRC scores, not directly comparable to old English metrics. Empty/punctuation-only outputs and NO_ANSWER get0. Format validity recorded independently.
procedure: Freeze data, source, config and model-file hashes before any model inference. Run FP16 and Q8 once each, all96rows. No Q4 selection, no training, no prompt iteration or old dataset inference. Q8 selected before these new predictions in v4; retain all gains/regressions, no tuning after results.
scope: Zero-shot Chinese answerable reading comprehension portability check. Official public CMRC dev subset, not official hidden test, not enterprise data, and potential pretraining contamination. No unanswerable rows, so hallucination/abstention under missing evidence untested.
fees: Free public-data download; local cached model inference, no paid API or publication.
